summary: Define the Hermes and Telegram operation contract
description: Map natural-language outcomes to deterministic arrctl operations, authority levels, concise progress, and evidence-backed final responses.
acceptance: Common operator intents map to explicit read-only or mutation authority.
Destructive or ambiguous instructions stop at an explainable human gate.
Final response fixtures are concise and include evidence or a precise blocker.
The Hermes command contract executes through arrctl-runner while Telegram and Hermes credentials remain outside Compose.
All returned JSON is deterministic and redacted.
